mcqs.q: Which Pakistani city was officially designated as the Economic Cooperation Organisation (ECO) Tourism Capital for the year 2027?
mcqs.explanation: Lahore formally received the title of ECO Tourism Capital for 2027 during a handover ceremony held in Shusha, Azerbaijan. Shusha served as the tourism capital for 2026. [Dawn]

mcqs.q: In November 2026, the COP31 UN climate conference was hosted in which city under a joint presidency arrangement between Australia and the host nation?
mcqs.explanation: The COP31 summit took place in Antalya, Turkiye, under a split presidency arrangement between Australia and Turkiye. [Dawn]

mcqs.q: In November 2026, the International Court of Justice (ICJ) ruled that which state's military committed state-sponsored genocide against the Rohingya population in 2017?
mcqs.explanation: The ICJ held the Republic of the Union of Myanmar responsible for state-sponsored genocide against Rohingya Muslims in Rakhine State. The case was originally brought before the court by The Gambia in 2019. [Dawn]

mcqs.q: Which Turkish seismic research vessel arrived in Pakistan in November 2026 to begin offshore oil and gas exploration after a 20-year hiatus?
mcqs.explanation: Turkiye's research vessel Oruc Reis arrived in Karachi to conduct seismic surveys assessing offshore hydrocarbon reserves. The initiative represents Pakistan's first major offshore exploration push in two decades. [The Express Tribune]

mcqs.q: In November 2026, a two-judge bench of the Federal Constitutional Court set aside high court decisions upholding the infrastructure cess imposed by which two provinces?
mcqs.explanation: A Federal Constitutional Court bench headed by Chief Justice Aminuddin Khan struck down decisions from the Sindh and Peshawar High Courts regarding provincial infrastructure cesses. [Dawn]

mcqs.q: Who visited Islamabad in November 2026 as the Secretary General of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) for bilateral talks with Pakistan?
mcqs.explanation: ASEAN Secretary General Dr Kao Kim Hourn held delegation-level discussions with Deputy Prime Minister Ishaq Dar on political, economic, and non-traditional security cooperation. [Dawn]

mcqs.q: Under the defence agreement with Denmark ratified in November 2026, the United States received permission to install which missile defence system in Greenland?
mcqs.explanation: The ratified executive agreement expanded the US military presence in Greenland and allowed the deployment of a Golden Dome missile defence installation. [The Express Tribune]

mcqs.q: In November 2026, Pakistan's Federal Constabulary signed a security cooperation agreement and anti-narcotics action plan with which Qatari security force?
mcqs.explanation: The memorandum of understanding was signed between Qatar's Internal Security Force (Lekhwiya) and Pakistan's Federal Constabulary during the Qatari interior minister's visit to Rawalpindi. [Dawn]

mcqs.q: In November 2026, Pakistan's Privatisation Commission signed an advisory agreement for outsourcing Karachi and Lahore international airports with a consortium led by which firm?
mcqs.explanation: The Privatisation Commission signed a Financial Advisory Services Agreement with an EY Middle East-led consortium to structure concession contracts for Jinnah and Allama Iqbal International Airports. [Dawn]

mcqs.q: Who serves as the first secretary-general of the trilateral Makkah Defence Alliance established by Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, and Turkiye?
mcqs.explanation: Nauman Mahmood was appointed as the first secretary-general of the Makkah Defence Alliance for a three-year term following an agreement reached by the founding member states. [The Express Tribune]

mcqs.q: In November 2026, the leaders of the United States, China, and Russia signed a trilateral 'Declaration toward Peace' following a meeting in which Chinese city?
mcqs.explanation: Presidents Donald Trump, Xi Jinping, and Vladimir Putin met at Kylin Villa in Shenzhen, China, where they issued a joint declaration pledging strategic stability and UN reform. [Dawn]

mcqs.q: According to the Pakistan Civil Aviation Authority, Pakistan's airspace is divided into which two Flight Information Regions (FIRs)?
mcqs.explanation: Pakistan's sovereign airspace comprises two designated Flight Information Regions: Karachi (OPKR) and Lahore (OPLR). [Dawn]

mcqs.q: In November 2026, which law enforcement agency uncovered an online betting and money laundering operation in Pakistan with an exposure of up to Rs1 trillion?
mcqs.explanation: The National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency (NCCIA) detected a massive network running illegal online betting portals and moving funds through mule accounts and digital wallets. [Dawn]

mcqs.q: What was the official theme selected for World Children's Day observed on November 20, 2026?
options: A Better Future for Every Child
My Day. My Rights. My Future
mcqs.explanation: World Children's Day 2026 was marked under the theme 'My Day. My Rights. My Future' to highlight the protection of fundamental rights for children globally. [The Express Tribune]

mcqs.q: In November 2026, the United Kingdom sanctioned Israeli construction firms over settlement activity, shortly ahead of tender deadlines for which controversial West Bank plan?
mcqs.explanation: The UK enacted asset freezes targeting construction firms ahead of the E1 tender, a project designed to bisect the West Bank and sever it from East Jerusalem. [The Express Tribune]

mcqs.q: In the November 2026 US midterm elections, which Democratic politician defeated incumbent Republican Governor Greg Abbott in the Texas gubernatorial race?
mcqs.explanation: Democrat Gina Hinojosa defeated Republican incumbent Greg Abbott to win the governorship of Texas during the 2026 midterm elections. [The Express Tribune]
